response: Yes, normothermic normokalemic simultaneous antegrade/retrograde perfusion can improve myocardial oxygenation and energy metabolism for hypertrophied hearts. This technique helps to enhance blood flow and oxygen delivery to the heart muscle, which can be particularly beneficial for hypertrophied hearts that may have increased oxygen demands. By improving myocardial oxygenation and energy metabolism, this perfusion method can help to reduce ischemic damage and support cardiac function in hypertrophied hearts.
